name: asb-bridge
description: Discover and message live Claude Code sessions and Codex tasks through local UDS inboxes. Part of ASB.

interface.shortDescription: Exchange messages with local Claude Code sessions.
interface.longDescription: Session lifecycle hooks make this task discoverable through Claude ListAgents. Peer messages steer its active turn or start a new turn when idle. MCP provides listing, sending, status, and inbox controls.
interface.defaultPrompt: Show my local agent sessions and this task's receive status.
